title: Origin story: Odysseus
description: Odysseus was king of Ithaca, son of Laertes, famed for a mind sharper than any sword in the Greek host. He devised the wooden horse that ended the ten-year Trojan War, then angered Poseidon by blinding the Cyclops Polyphemus, earning a decade of wandering across the wine-dark sea before he could reach home.

title: Ability profile: Odysseus
description: Ranked abilities: Cunning and trickery — rank 100/100; Endurance — rank 93/100; Leadership — rank 91/100; Seamanship — rank 90/100; Archery — rank 88/100.

title: Power ranking: Odysseus
description: Powers: The devising mind — no trap or riddle holds him long; Favor of Athena in his darkest hours; An iron will that outlasts gods' grudges.

title: Stamina feats: Odysseus
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Endured ten years of war and ten years of wandering without breaking; Swam for days after his ship was shattered, refusing to drown.

title: Crossover notes: Odysseus
description: Odysseus crosses naturally with: cunning, endurance, seamanship, survival.

title: Cultural impact: Odysseus
description: The original survivor-hero; his name is shorthand for the long road home.
